android.description: Customize on-screen buttons and play with touch, motion or a controller. Use your phone keyboard, microphone and clipboard with your remote PC.
android.detail: Client for Android phones and tablets
android.name: Android
android.note: Keyboard assistance, clipboard and microphone require permissions and host support. HDR requires compatible hardware and displays.

android-tv.description: Use V+ on a TV or TV box to play PC games with a controller. Open in-stream controls to adjust video and inspect performance.
android-tv.detail: Android TV client · For TV devices
android-tv.name: Android TV
android-tv.note: HDR, audio and controller feedback depend on the TV, OS, connected devices and host support.

apple-tv.description: Browse and play with a controller on Apple TV, bringing your gaming PC to the living-room screen.
apple-tv.detail: Apple TV client · Install from the App Store
apple-tv.name: Apple TV
apple-tv.note: The tvOS version requires a controller. HDR needs a compatible host and Apple TV. Install the official release from the App Store.

harmony.description: Play PC games with touch, on-screen buttons and native HarmonyOS controllers, with motion input, audio-driven haptics and HDR display support.
harmony.detail: HarmonyOS NEXT client · Install from AppGallery
harmony.name: HarmonyOS NEXT
harmony.note: HDR and host extensions require compatible devices and Foundation Sunshine. Microphone forwarding is currently available in developer mode.

ios.name: iPhone / iPad
ios.note: HDR, PiP, interpolation and stylus features depend on your device and OS. Some advanced drawing features require an in-app purchase.

linux.note: Choose the package for your architecture and system. HDR and clipboard availability depend on the Linux desktop environment.

macos.name: macOS
macos.note: Current downloads target Apple Silicon. Clipboard, microphone and shared files require host support.

macos-enhanced.note: macOS 12+, Apple Silicon and Intel. Clipboard, microphone and host controls require host support.

quest.description: Use the V+ Android client on Quest to receive PC video, adjust in-stream settings and inspect performance.

quest.note: This download is an Android APK. Input, display and HDR availability depend on the headset environment.

steam.description: A dedicated build for Valve Steam Link hardware. Connect to your gaming PC and play on your TV with a controller.
steam.name: Steam Link
steam.note: This build targets Steam Link hardware and does not support HDR or microphone forwarding.
